model._comment: relabel strips the montage's existing contact-lens ring back to the surrounding tissue so the parametric electrode below is placed on clean anatomy

eye._comment: origin = least-squares centre of the retina shell; +e3 = corneal axis (away from the retina centroid). Fitted radius ~3.155 mm, RMS 0.048 mm.

geometry._comment: equivalently frame.ring(3.360, 53.3, 0.12): a 240 um wire ring lying on the r = 3.36 mm eye surface, 53.3 deg off the corneal apex

electrodes.name: J
electrodes._comment: adopt the J electrode already painted in the anatomy; supernode ties all of its pieces to 0 V, which the legacy single ground node did not
